articles.title: Qualcomm's CMO reveals the secret behind Snapdragon's rise
articles.description: Qualcomm CMO Don McGuire joins In The Loop host Ejaaz Ahamadeen at Qualcomm’s Snapdragon Summit in Maui, for an in-depth look at how a chip you can't even buy off a shelf became one of the biggest brands in tech, sports, and AI. He breaks down the brand strategy turning an invisible chip into a household name, why Microsoft's consumer Surface lineup is now 100% powered by Snapdragon, and the company’s groundbreaking partnerships with Manchester United and Mercedes F1.
